title: Purple Magic Poses
description: Four vertical panels display the same dark-skinned female warrior with short white hair in different combat stances. She wears a purple and white tribal outfit with leaf-like armor, white handprints on her thighs, and purple wraps on her feet and arms. In all poses she channels glowing purple magical energy and floating crystalline shards that swirl around her hands and body.
